pollutants, BOD and its modelling, Rock drainage. Groundwater: characteristics,
pollution, modelling; water treatment technologies: active and passive

estimation and control. Soil erosion control methods .Air pollution: effects,
Gaseous pollutants and dust, classification. Effects of criteria pollutants on
normal and COPD subjects. Air pollution Control, Noise pollution and control,
Environmental Risk. EIA, EMP and environmental monitoring.

 It is the largest Hall Of Residence in the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur. Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Hall of Residence is known for its strong sense of community and camaraderie among its residents. Hall History and Culture


The hall culture is a vital component of the fabric of IIT Kharagpur. The hall you reside in plays a pivotal role in your personal growth and development, refining your character from a youthful student to a mature and sophisticated individual. Historically, the strength of the hall culture was believed to be proportional to its age; however, the students at Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Hall of Residence defied these expectations and left an indelible mark on KGP history. The students exhibited remarkable determination and discipline, which enabled them to secure a commendable fourth position in the Illumination 2019 and second position in the Illumination 2022 competition.

Undoubtedly, the senior-junior culture is a charming aspect of KGP culture, and Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Hall of Residence is renowned for its supportive and empathetic senior students. selected area and convergent beam electron diffraction patterns. Analysis of
